response.sql: WITH filtered AS (SELECT k_symbol, amount FROM `order` WHERE amount >= 2802), per_purpose AS (SELECT k_symbol, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM filtered GROUP BY k_symbol), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg FROM per_purpose) SELECT p.k_symbol, p.avg_amount, p.avg_amount - o.overall_avg AS excess_over_overall FROM per_purpose p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_amount > o.overall_avg ORDER BY excess_over_overall DESC;

assumptions.assumption: Standing orders are the rows of the `order` table, and the threshold applies to `order.amount` (inclusive, amount >= 2802).
The blank purpose code is the empty string '' (the column is NOT NULL, so no NULLs are expected). GROUP BY already keeps '' as its own group. Whitespace-only values are not treated as blank.
The overall figure is the unweighted mean of the per-purpose averages, computed over the purpose groups that remain after the amount filter. Each purpose average is unrounded.

alternatives.interpretation: Treat whitespace-only purpose codes as blank by trimming before grouping, so ' ' and '' fall into the same blank group.
alternatives.sql: WITH filtered AS (SELECT CASE WHEN TRIM(k_symbol) = '' THEN '' ELSE k_symbol END AS k_symbol, amount FROM `order` WHERE amount >= 2802), per_purpose AS (SELECT k_symbol, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM filtered GROUP BY k_symbol), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg FROM per_purpose) SELECT p.k_symbol, p.avg_amount, p.avg_amount - o.overall_avg AS excess_over_overall FROM per_purpose p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_amount > o.overall_avg ORDER BY excess_over_overall DESC;
